description: List suppliers, optionally filtered by code prefix, contact email prefix or modification date. Unleashed: GET /Suppliers/{page}.

contactEmail.description: Only suppliers whose contact email starts with this.

modifiedSince.description: Only records created or modified since this UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).

pageSize.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Unleashed default is 200.

supplierCode.description: Only suppliers whose code starts with this.
